Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 1. Overview

PoolingAutomationSynergy is an enterprise desktop application built to
automate merchant fund pooling, ACH-based payment processing, and
cash flow management for organizations that consolidate funds across
multiple merchant accounts, client groups, or business locations.

The application gives finance and treasury teams a single, integrated
system to calculate pooled amounts, move funds through the ACH network,
track payment status end-to-end, reconcile pooled versus processed
amounts, and generate and distribute financial reports — all from one
desktop workspace.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 2. Business Context

Organizations that manage many merchant accounts or business locations
typically need to:

• Consolidate (“pool”) funds across those accounts regularly

• Move the resulting funds through ACH payment processing

• Track the status of every payment leg, including rejections and corrections

• Reconcile what was pooled against what was actually processed

• Produce accurate, auditable financial reports for internal and client use

Handling this manually across many merchant accounts is time-consuming and
error-prone. PoolingAutomationSynergy centralizes the entire workflow — from
pooling calculation through payment processing, reconciliation, and reporting —
into a single, purpose-built system.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.1 Login & Navigation

Users authenticate through a secure login screen. Once signed in, they
land on a central dashboard that serves as both an operational summary
and the primary navigation hub for every workflow in the application, giving
users quick access to client management, pooling controls, ACH
processing, reporting, and administration from one place.

• Maintain client/corporate groups — banking details, preferred ACH

processing partner, pooling type (Corporate, Location, or Hybrid), and
account hold status

• Maintain individual merchant records within each group, including

local bank account details

• Track group notes, contacts (used for automated report distribution),

and historical activity

• A built-in suggestion engine detects unmatched or missing

merchant-to-group links and lets staff resolve them quickly

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.3 Pooling Calculation Engine

• Select a pooling type and a reporting date range

• The calculation engine consolidates the relevant transaction data for

the selected clients

• Supports both bulk processing (all eligible client groups at once) and

single-group processing

• Each calculation run produces a Pooling Control — an auditable unit

of work that all downstream ACH processing is tied back to

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.4 ACH Payment Processing

• Generates properly formatted ACH payment files compatible with

multiple ACH processing partners

• Finalizes merchant-level, corporate-level, and hybrid payment legs

independently, with amount previews before submission

• Imports and reconciles ACH response files from processing

partners, automatically updating payment status for every transaction

• A dedicated workflow identifies rejected or declined items, allows

correction, and resubmits them for processing

• Supports ad hoc, one-off ACH payments outside the standard

pooling cycle

• Full, searchable ACH transaction history, with manual status

correction and a note trail for every change

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.5 Cash Flow Reporting

An on-demand, parameterized cash flow report lets users select any date
range and generate a polished, print-ready report directly within the
application — giving treasury teams an up-to-date view of fund movement
without leaving the workflow.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.6 Reconciliation & Audit

• A dedicated reconciliation report compares pooled amounts against

what was actually processed through ACH, surfacing discrepancies
for review

• A complete audit trail records every material change to client and

merchant banking configuration, tagged to the user who made it

• A full historical view of every pooling run ever created, including its

complete processing and funding history

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.7 Automated Report Distribution

Previously generated reports can be selected and routed automatically to
the correct client contacts by email, with a searchable log of everything
sent — including recipient and timestamp — for accountability and
follow-up.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 4. Functional Modules > 4.8 Administrative Controls

• Sensitive banking configuration changes sit behind a

password-gated access control

• A live dashboard summarizes overall system health at a glance:

pending pooling runs, ACH status breakdowns, active vs. on-hold
clients, and outstanding group-link suggestions

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 6. Reporting & Analytics

The dashboard provides an at-a-glance operational view, including:

• Payment status breakdown across all ACH transactions

• Active vs. on-hold client groups

• Processed vs. unprocessed pooling runs within a selected date

range

• Outstanding merchant/group-link suggestions requiring attention

• A flagged summary grid — one row per active client group, showing

its most recent pooling run status at a glance

Supplementing this, dedicated report views cover pooling run history, ACH
funding detail, formal reconciliation, and a full audit trail — all rendered to
print-ready PDF from within the application.

Section: TECSACK SOFTWARE > 8. Value Delivered

• Consolidates merchant pooling and ACH payment operations into a

single, cohesive system

• Reduces manual effort and error risk in ACH file generation and

bank-response handling

• Improves financial traceability and audit-readiness through built-in,

user-tagged audit logging

• Streamlines reconciliation between pooled and processed amounts

• Automates recurring report generation and distribution to client

stakeholders
